info.name: Register a consumer click and receive a tracked destination URL

items.docs: Server-to-server click registration for CJ partners. Returns the final landing page URL carrying the `cjevent` tracking parameter; the partner is responsible for navigating the consumer to it, and for falling back to a traditional CJ tracking Click URL on any error. Cannot be called from a browser. CJ asks partners to contact their CJ representative for integration validation before implementing.
